title: RELEASE BLOCKER: baselines restamped to 1.3.0 before ship, so any 1.3.0 rebuild produces useless update bundles
description: Found 2026-07-30 while rebuilding 1.3.0 to carry the MPI-406/407/408 fixes. Commit 36f972cf (17:10:36) restamped release-baselines/*.json from the shipped 1.3.0 FULL manifests - counts went 6362/6325/6505 (the 1.2.0 manifests) to 6418/6383/6563 (1.3.0). The original CI run 30559394491 built its artifacts at 17:06-17:07, BEFORE the restamp, so its update bundles were correct deltas from 1.2.0 (windows 451102241, linux 2782980, macos 3308757). Every rebuild since uses the 1.3.0 baselines, so build-portable's applyDelta (scripts/build-portable.mjs:709) prunes everything whose SHA256 already matches 1.3.0 and emits a 1.3.0-to-1.3.0 delta: run 30588169394 produced windows 970553, linux 971302, macos 1472703 - just the three changed source files. A user on 1.2.0 applying one of those would receive almost nothing. THIS MATTERS: v1.2.0's GitHub release DOES attach all three update zips (~95MB each, verified via gh release view), so they are real release assets, not local-only files. The restamp itself is correct PRACTICE but was done at the wrong TIME - baselines describe the PREVIOUS release and must not be advanced until the new one has actually shipped. FIX for the 1.3.0 ship: restore release-baselines/*.json to their 36f972cf~1 content (the 1.2.0 manifests), rebuild, confirm the update bundles are back to roughly 451MB/2.8MB/3.3MB and that each update-manifest.json reads fromVersion 1.2.0, publish, and only THEN restamp to 1.3.0 for 1.4.0. Longer term: consider making the restamp part of the post-publish step so it cannot run early. Current state: D:/CubricStudio/Vision/Builds/v1.3.0/ holds the three NEW full artifacts (fulls do not depend on baselines, so they are valid and carry the fixes); the stale update zips are quarantined in an INVALID-update-bundles-see-MPI-409 subfolder.

attention.reason: Awaiting the user: confirm the v1.3.0 tag moves to baefe4c3 (build #5 superseded the approved 3cb4a58d), publish the six artifacts, then restamp release-baselines to 6418/6383/6563 - the last item on this card.
